title: A clinical trial of tulisokibart in participants with active, non-infectious uveitis
official: A Phase 2b, Randomized, Double-Masked, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Tulisokibart in Participants with Active Noninfectious Intermediate, Posterior, or Panuveitis
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of tulisokibart versus placebo as measured by the time to treatment failure occurring on or after Week 6 through Week 50
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has active noninfectious intermediate uveitis, posterior uveitis, or panuveitis (NIIPPU) at screening and baseline in at least one eye
2. Meets prior stable dose and duration requirements before baseline for permitted immunosuppressive therapies and corticosteroids
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has isolated anterior uveitis
2. Has a planned eye surgery during the double-masked treatment period (DMP)
3. History of refractive laser surgery, laser surgery of the macula (including photodynamic therapy or focal laser photocoagulation), retinal laser photocoagulation, or neodymium-doped yttrium aluminum garnet posterior capsulotomy ≤30 days before baseline
4. History of any other prior ocular surgery ≤3 months before baseline except surgery for cosmetic reasons that is not expected to impact vision
5. Has had major surgery within 3 months prior to Screening or has a major surgery (ie, surgical procedure requiring general anesthesia) planned during the study
6. Has a contraindication for mydriatic eye drops or cannot be dilated sufficiently well to permit good fundus visualization
7. Has any condition preventing the evaluation/assessment of both eyes for eligibility criteria and efficacy assessment throughout the study
8. Has any other immune-mediated inflammatory condition that is not well controlled and that may require treatment with prohibited therapy
9. Has a transplanted organ and requires continued systemic immunosuppression
10. History of cancer (except fully treated nonmelanoma skin cancers or cervical carcinoma in situ after complete surgical removal) and is disease free for <5 years before baseline
11. Has had a diagnostic evaluation suggestive of malignancy (eg, chest or breast imaging) and the possibility of malignancy cannot be reasonably excluded following additional clinical assessments
12. Has macular edema as the only sign of intermediate, posterior, or panuveitis (NIIPPU)
13. Has any active infection
14. Has demonstrated intolerance to or prior inadequate response to high-dose oral corticosteroids (equivalent of oral prednisone 1mg/kg/day or ≥60 mg/day) to treat NIIPPU in the last 3 months before Screening.
15. Has had complications related to a glucocorticoid implant
16. Has known allergies, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to tulisokibart or its excipients
17. History of hypersensitivity to prednisone/prednisolone, or intolerance to corticosteroids
18. Has presumed ocular histoplasmosis syndrome
19. Has serpiginous choroidopatas proliferative or severe non-proliferative retinopathy or clinically significant macular edema due to diabetic retinopathy
20. Has proliferative or severe non-proliferative retinopathy or clinically significant macular edema due to diabetic retinopathy
21. Has neovascular/wet age-related macular degeneration
22. Has active scleritis ≤6 months from baseline
23. Has best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) <20 letters (ETDRS) in any eye at baseline
24. Has corneal or lens opacity that precludes visualization of the fundus or is likely to require cataract surgery during the study
